The '''Jompers pursuit ship''' was a customs [[Starship/Legends|ship]] described as "modern" in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], when the [[Frezh]]lix used thirty of them in their [[Blockade of Sif'kric|attempted blockade]] of [[Sif'kric]].
